statement: The Ford-Fulkerson method always terminates and returns a maximum flow, for any choice of augmenting paths.
definitions: Capacities are arbitrary non-negative real numbers (the standard Ford-Fulkerson setting; with integer or rational capacities the method does terminate). 'Ford-Fulkerson method' = repeatedly augment along ANY s-t path of the residual network by its bottleneck capacity, with the augmenting path chosen arbitrarily (adversarially) at each step. 'Terminates' = stops after finitely many augmentations. A counterexample is an explicit network and an explicit infinite legal augmentation schedule (or one that terminates at a non-maximum flow), with justification that the schedule remains legal forever.
ground_truth_witness: Flow network with vertices s, v1, v2, v3, v4, t. Let r = (sqrt(5)-1)/2, the positive root of r^2 = 1-r. Special arcs: e1 = v2->v1 capacity 1, e2 = v4->v3 capacity r, e3 = v2->v3 capacity 1. All remaining arcs s->v1, s->v2, s->v4, v1->t, v3->t, v4->t have capacity M (any integer M >= 2; M=5 used in the check). Augment along {s,v2,v3,t} once (sending 1), then repeat the 4-path cycle p1={s,v4,v3,v2,v1,t}, p2={s,v2,v3,v4,t}, p1, p3={s,v1,v2,v3,t}. After the first augmentation the residual capacities of (e1,e2,e3) are (r^0, r^1, 0), and each 4-path cycle returns them to the form (r^n, r^(n+1), 0) with n increased by 2. The augmentations therefore never stop, and the total flow increases to the limit 1 + 2*sum_{i>=1} r^i = 3+2r ~= 4.2360679, while the true maximum flow is 2M+1 = 11 (send M along s-v1-t, 1 along s-v2-v3-t, M along s-v4-t; the cut S={s,v1,v2} has capacity M+M+1 = 11, matching).
reference_authority: online-cited counterexample (MO/MSE/CS.SE/Wikipedia) with verify script, verified per partB_feasibility records

skeptic.objection: Claim is false for real-valued capacities: the Ford-Fulkerson method with adversarial augmenting-path choice need not terminate and can converge to a non-maximum value. Reference (Wikipedia's non-terminating example) verified numerically: after augmenting {s,v2,v3,t} the residuals of (e1,e2,e3) are (1, r, 0) and every 4-path cycle p1,p2,p1,p3 maps (r^n, r^(n+1), 0) to (r^(n+2), r^(n+3), 0) with every path a legal augmenting path (all bottlenecks positive), so the process never stops; the flow value increases 3, 3.764, 4.056, ... toward 3+2r = 4.236, while Edmonds-Karp gives the true maximum 2M+1 = 11 for M=5 (cut {s,v1,v2} has capacity 11). Requires a genuine, delicate construction (irrational capacities and a specific path schedule) plus its verification; famous but not reproducible by name alone. Distinct from surplus cb-cs-se-ford-fulkerson-augmentation-count (integer capacities, bound on iteration count, 1000/1000/1 witness).

bank_overlap.rationale: Only Ford-Fulkerson entries are qedbench-algorithms-23-sol4 (antiparallel edges break the residual-flow identity) and qedbugbank-maxflow-mutant-kills (Edmonds-Karp mutants); no entry refutes termination for arbitrary augmenting paths and no irrational-capacity (golden-ratio) network appears anywhere (grep irrational/golden ratio/sqrt(5) hits only unrelated analysis/number-theory entries).
